## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{python, newtemplate}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Constants
excel_file_name = 'fitting_mci_doc_cod/COD Coding Input template_1.xlsx'
sub_sheet = 'Sheet1'
keywords_excel = 'fitting_mci_doc_cod/final_kw_v1.xlsx'
kw_sub_sheet = 'adapted_keywords'

if __name__ == "__main__":

# =========================
    # BLOCK 1: Manner Extraction (Substring Match)
    # =========================
    try:
        df = pd.read_excel(excel_file_name, sheet_name=sub_sheet, engine='openpyxl')

        # Clean and standardize
        df['MANNER'] = df['MANNER'].fillna("").str.strip().str.lower()
        df['CAUSE'] = df['CAUSE'].fillna("").str.strip().str.upper()

        # Extract manner flags using substring matching
        df['ACCIDENT'] = df['MANNER'].str.contains('accident', na=False)
        df['HOMICIDE'] = df['MANNER'].str.contains('homicide', na=False)
        df['SUICIDE'] = df['MANNER'].str.contains('suicide', na=False)
        df['PENDING'] = df['MANNER'].str.contains('pending', na=False)
        df['UNKNOWN'] = df['MANNER'].str.contains('unknown', na=False) | df['MANNER'].str.contains('undetermined', na=False)
        
        # FIXED: Mark NATURAL as True if manner contains "natural" OR "illness"
        df['NATURAL'] = df['MANNER'].str.contains('natural', na=False) | df['MANNER'].str.contains('illness', na=False)

    except Exception as e:
        print('Exception in Block 1:', e)
        

    # =========================
    # BLOCK 2: Keyword Loading (Updated Columns)
    # =========================
    try:
        kw_df = pd.read_excel(keywords_excel, sheet_name=kw_sub_sheet, engine='openpyxl')

        # Reading the 10 exact keyword columns from your new sheet
        od_keywords = kw_df['OVERDOSE KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        cold_keywords = kw_df['COLD KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        heat_keywords = kw_df['HEAT KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        suicide_keywords = kw_df['SUICIDE KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        homicide_keywords = kw_df['HOMICIDE KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        inj_keywords = kw_df['INJURY KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        heart_keywords = kw_df['HEART KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        comm_keywords = kw_df['COMMUNICABLE DISEASE KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        non_comm_keywords = kw_df['NON-COMMUNICABLE DISEASE KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()
        illness_keywords = kw_df['ILLNESS KEYWORDS'].dropna().astype(str).str.upper().tolist()

    except Exception as e:
        print('Exception in Block 2:', e)

# =========================
    # BLOCK 3 & 4: Cause Extraction & Hierarchical Roll-up
    # =========================
    try:
        # 1. Initialize the 10 specific cause categories
        df['FINAL_OD'] = False
        df['FINAL_COLD'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEAT'] = False
        df['FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE'] = False
        df['FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE'] = False
        df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY'] = False
        df['FINAL_HEART'] = False
        df['FINAL_COMM_DISEASE'] = False
        df['FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE'] = False
        df['FINAL_ILLNESS'] = False
        df['FINAL_UNDETERMINED_CAUSE'] = False # Added to track explicit undetermined keywords

        # Run string contains checks purely on CAUSE text
        for kw in od_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_OD'] = True

        for kw in cold_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_COLD'] = True

        for kw in heat_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_HEAT'] = True

        for kw in suicide_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE'] = True

        for kw in homicide_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE'] = True

        for kw in inj_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_OTHER_INJURY'] = True

        for kw in heart_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_HEART'] = True

        for kw in comm_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_COMM_DISEASE'] = True

        for kw in non_comm_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE'] = True

        for kw in illness_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_ILLNESS'] = True

        # Assume you still have undetermined_keywords from previous block
        for kw in undetermined_keywords:
            df.loc[df['CAUSE'].str.contains(kw, na=False), 'FINAL_UNDETERMINED_CAUSE'] = True

# ---------------------------------------------------------
        # 2. HIERARCHY MAPPING (Safe OR Logic)
        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        
        # Non-Communicable is True if it matched its own keywords OR if it's a Heart condition
        df['FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE'] = df['FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE'] | df['FINAL_HEART']

        # Sub-branches
        df['CAUSE_ACCIDENTAL'] = df['FINAL_COLD'] | df['FINAL_HEAT'] | df['FINAL_OD'] | df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY']
        df['CAUSE_INTENTIONAL'] = df['FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE'] | df['FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE']
        
        # Main Branches
        df['CAUSE_EXTERNAL'] = df['CAUSE_ACCIDENTAL'] | df['CAUSE_INTENTIONAL']
        df['CAUSE_INTERNAL'] = df['FINAL_COMM_DISEASE'] | df['FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE'] | df['FINAL_ILLNESS']
        df['CAUSE_UNDETERMINED'] = df['FINAL_UNDETERMINED_CAUSE']

        # Manual review tracking
        all_cause_branches = ['CAUSE_EXTERNAL', 'CAUSE_INTERNAL', 'CAUSE_UNDETERMINED']
        df['MANUAL'] = ~df[all_cause_branches].any(axis=1)
        
# =========================
    # BLOCK 5: Mapping Final Code Outputs
    # =========================
    try:
        df['COD'] = 0

        # 1. Map the broader hierarchical branches first
        df.loc[df['CAUSE_UNDETERMINED'], 'COD'] = 99  # Example fallback for undetermined
        
        # 2. Map specific categories (Order matters: lowest priority to highest priority)
        df.loc[df['FINAL_ILLNESS'], 'COD'] = 10
        df.loc[df['FINAL_NON_COMM_DISEASE'], 'COD'] = 9 
        df.loc[df['FINAL_COMM_DISEASE'], 'COD'] = 8
        
        # This sits BELOW non-communicable disease, so heart cases get correctly stamped as 7
        df.loc[df['FINAL_HEART'], 'COD'] = 7 
        
        df.loc[df['FINAL_OTHER_INJURY'], 'COD'] = 6
        df.loc[df['FINAL_HOMICIDE_CAUSE'], 'COD'] = 5
        df.loc[df['FINAL_SUICIDE_CAUSE'], 'COD'] = 4
        df.loc[df['FINAL_COLD'], 'COD'] = 3
        df.loc[df['FINAL_HEAT'], 'COD'] = 2
        df.loc[df['FINAL_OD'], 'COD'] = 1
        
        # If no cause keywords matched at all
        df.loc[df['MANUAL'], 'COD'] = 0

    except Exception as e:
        print('Exception in Block 5:', e)

    # Save
    df.to_excel('fitting_mci_doc_cod/test_cod_output_1.xlsx', index=False)
```
